name: Firm-level interest coverage ratio (simple threshold)

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: whether earnings are enough to cover interest expenses
notes: The paper smooths seasonality with four-quarter sums; the annual figures in the data are used instead.
quote: First, a simple threshold of 1, below which a firm cannot completely cover its interest expenses using earnings.

name: Free cash flow relative to total assets

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: how much cash the business generates after interest, taxes and investment, relative to its size
notes: Operating income before depreciation is taken as operating_income plus depreciation.
quote: Free cash flow is computed as operating income before depreciation minus interest expenses minus taxes minus capital expenditures.

name: Leverage (total debt over assets)

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: how much of the company's assets is financed by debt
quote: leverage, expressed as total debt over assets

name: Credit line availability (undrawn lines of credit over assets)

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: how much unused borrowing capacity the company has as a buffer
quote: credit line availability, expressed as total undrawn lines of credit over assets

name: Share of debt maturing within a year

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: how much of the debt has to be repaid or refinanced within a year
quote: only around 4 percent of debt matures within a year

name: Debt composition (bonds relative to total debt)

paper.title: Interest Coverage Ratios: Assessing Vulnerabilities in Nonfinancial Corporate Credit

diagnoses: the mix of bonds and loans in the company's debt
quote: the median share of bonds relative to total debt
